zone_rule.structure: Strict close crossing the latest matching pivot value already known on the prior close. Previous close at or inside edge. Symmetric.
zone_rule.atr: Wilder ATR14 of closed chart bars
zone_rule.origin: Nearest opposite-bodied closed candle among ages 1..5 whose wick-to-open geometry is within inclusive width limits. Stop scanning at first non-contiguous boundary. Require contiguous current and previous bars.
zone_rule.fvg: Existing same-close 3-bar directional FVG, minimum gap 0.04 ATR14, context only
zone_rule.identity: symbol, timeframe, side, formation close timestamp and origin open timestamp

lifecycle.order: Existing zones first: age 24 expiry, close invalidation, actual range intersection first touch, wick mitigation, rejection; then formation, replacing prior same-side survivor.
lifecycle.first_touch: Later bar with actual range intersecting bounds; gap-through without overlap is not touch.
lifecycle.partial: First wick penetration strictly beyond proximal with range overlap; full skips partial if never logged.
lifecycle.full: First range overlap reaching distal wick; keep active until invalidation, expiry or replacement.
lifecycle.rejection: Once, after first touch (may share first-touch bar), contiguous bar and overlap or prior close within bounds; strict close beyond proximal and same-direction body >= 0.25 current ATR14.
lifecycle.status_priority: Terminal > rejection observed > deepest mitigation > first touch > untested.
lifecycle.notification: Optional and off by default, realtime confirmed-bar TOUCH, REJECTION and INVALIDATED once each per zone/event; research only, existing alerts untouched.

evaluation.false_reversal: Confirmed close past distal by >=0.10 frozen rejection ATR in next 3/6/12 contiguous bars. Censor at data end or gaps; ex-post only.
evaluation.independent_events: Previously registered independent hourly archive event definition, both directions. Main displacement = first same-direction completed chart close >=0.75 x prior event scale from hour open. Count pre-main strictly before that close.
evaluation.case_utc: 2026-11-11 00:00 to 17:30 inclusive where archived OANDA chart rows exist
evaluation.execution: Diagnostic only: next open after rejection; signal anchor rejection close; stop one tick beyond distal; 1/2/3R geometry; existing quote-side gap and stop-first controls, 0.20 ATR max adverse open deviation, 250 cash cap, single occupancy. Keep filled, blocked and rejected separate.
evaluation.holdout: No sealed period access. Archive is exploratory; prospective untouched test not started, no earlier than 2027-05-01.
evaluation.news: No news classification without evidence; distinguish OHLC shock proxy from actual scheduled news.
